config.note: v44: the OsmAnd Skill first opens the task's region (the country after the comma) so the map moves there; a manual check then found the first waypoint without widening the search radius, which the model had abandoned. v43 rejects Type when no GUI tree exists and Android reports no focused text field (it would type into nothing), and the OsmAnd reminder adds the rules ignored in the v42 final evaluation (settlement rows only, never the Favorite button, finish one waypoint first). v42 counts more than 50 clearly changed full-resolution pixels as a visible effect, so small label changes (OsmAnd's search radius) are not mistaken for no progress. v41: the Skill reminder and file state that an empty search result needs INCREASE SEARCH RADIUS, not SHOW ON MAP or zooming. v40: with the Skill enabled, every step's user message restates the waypoint search terms (the system-prompt Skill alone was not followed). v39 keeps the goal turn plus the latest 19 executed turns in each request (an 88-step run hit the provider's prompt limit), stops when a block of 2-6 actions repeats three times in a row, and lets the OsmAnd Skill list each waypoint's search term. v38 allows ten unchanged Waits in a row (was five): a cold OsmAnd start after the snapshot restore showed its logo for over 40 s on the software-rendered emulator. v37 allows 60 s per typed word (was 10 s): OsmAnd searches on every character and one word exceeded 10 s on the software-rendered emulator. v36 bounds unchanged Wait actions separately (stop after five in a row) so a slow splash screen is not mistaken for a no-progress cycle; other actions keep the v29 cycle stop. v35 confirms each screen-recorder clip survives encoder start-up (1.5 s) before GUI actions resume and starts a new clip otherwise (observed: 'unable to configure video/avc codec ... err=-38'); agent behaviour unchanged from v34. v34 keeps the shared ADB server when android_env retries a timed-out command (its kill-server also ended the screen recorder) and adds an optional per-task Skill: instructions/skills/osmand_track.md for OsmAndTrack, written from a manual exploration that passed the official track matcher. evaluate_tasks.py --disable-skills runs the same code without it. v33 launches apps with a 30-second `am start -W` timeout: Android World's 5 seconds expired on a cold OsmAnd start, android_env then restarted the ADB server and that also ended the screen recorder. v32 replaces a recorder clip that ends early (polled each second, logged as RECORDING NOTE) and closes a host adb shell that does not return after SIGINT; agent behaviour unchanged from v31. v31 resolves Launch names like upstream Open-AutoGLM (case/spacing-insensitive; a translated non-Latin name resolves only when exactly one app is allowed) and stops on all-black screenshots as a rendering infrastructure error. v30 adds SimpleCalendarAddOneEvent (medium) and OsmAndTrack (hard) with visible completion rules and initial step/time budgets of about 2x and 1.5x their 17/60 reference steps, to be revised from learning trials; Calendar verifier rows are withheld from model inputs. v29 follows pinned Open-AutoGLM English contract and sourced Android World guidance. Long task recipes and Clock keypad Type exception withdrawn. Short visible goals, ordered native history, latest screenshot, checked GUI state and actual selected-control feedback. Bounded recorder readiness and observed EditText recognition repair recorded adapter faults. Scheduler stops at the first failed clean trial; repeated unchanged action cycles stop without forcing completion. Sixteen offline checks; live task-specific v20/v28 gates and unresolved Timer/Clipboard errors are in docs/WARMUP_RESULTS.md. Sources/slide mapping: docs/COURSE_AND_UPSTREAM_REVIEW.md.

data.goal: Save a track with waypoints Planken, Liechtenstein, Rotenboden, Liechtenstein in the OsmAnd maps app in the same order as listed.

data:
The screen is the home screen with no app open. To start the task, I need to launch the OsmAnd maps app.


do(action="Launch", app="osmand")

The OsmAnd app is loading ( splash screen). I should wait for it to finish loading before proceeding to the next step.

do(action="Wait", duration="1 seconds")

The OsmAnd app is now open and showing the map. To start creating the track, I need to open the search function to look for the first waypoint "Planken, Liechtenstein". The Search button is the magnifying glass icon at [134,59,241,108].


do(action="Tap", element=[187,83])

The search button was tapped but the search interface hasn't appeared yet. I should wait a moment for the search interface to load before proceeding.


do(action="Wait", duration="1 seconds")

The search interface is open and the input field is focused. I should type the first waypoint name "Planken" (without the region, as instructed) to search for it.


do(action="Type", text="Planken")

The search result for "Planken" is shown with a "SHOW ON MAP" option. I should tap the "SHOW ON MAP" button to move the map to the location of Planken, Liechtenstein, which will allow me to proceed with planning the route from this point.


do(action="Tap", element=[455,141])

The map has moved to the location of Planken, Liechtenstein. To proceed with creating the track, I need to open the route planning interface. The "Back" button at [0,57,135,118] should take me back to the search results where I can access the route planning option.


do(action="Tap", element=[67,83])

The search result for "Planken" returned no results, possibly due to the search radius being too small. I should tap the "INCREASE SEARCH RADIUS" button to expand the search area and try to find the place again.


do(action="Tap", element=[499,335])

The search result still shows "Could not find anything: 10 mi". I should try increasing the search radius again to expand the search area further and locate the place of Planken, Liechtenstein.


do(action="Tap", element=[499,335])

The search result still shows "Could not find anything: 20 mi". I should try increasing the search radius again to expand the search area further and locate the place of Planken, Liechtenstein. This is the third time I've increased the radius; according to the instructions, I should stop after three radius increases if the search still doesn't find the place.


do(action="Tap", element=[499,335])


do(action="Tap", element=[499,335])

The search results now show multiple entries for "Planken". I should select the correct "Planken, Liechtenstein" entry, which is the "Planken" listed as a "Village" at [0,587,999,675], to ensure I'm using the right location for the first waypoint.


do(action="Tap", element=[499,615])

The map is now centered on Planken, Liechtenstein. To proceed with creating the track, I need to open the route planning interface. The "Actions" button at [799,849,999,917] should provide access to the route planning option, as per the instructions for the first waypoint.


do(action="Tap", element=[872,883])

The "Plan a route" option is visible in the menu. I should tap on "Plan a route" to start creating the track and set this location as the starting point.


do(action="Tap", element=[163,860])

The route panel is open with "0 ft, points: 1" displayed. To add the next waypoint, I should tap the "Add" button at [770,932,988,988] to search for and add the next waypoint, Rotenboden, Liechtenstein.


do(action="Tap", element=[862,943])

The "Add" button is now visible in the route panel. I should tap the "Add" button at [770,932,988,988] to search for and add the next waypoint, Rotenboden, Liechtenstein.


do(action="Tap", element=[862,943])

The "Add" button is still visible in the route panel. I should tap the "Add" button at [770,932,988,988] to search for and add the next waypoint, Rotenboden, Liechtenstein.


do(action="Tap", element=[862,943])
